category_title: Silent and depressed EMLLs experiencing extreme language-related frustration and school avoidance
scenario_title: Reading comprehension of a picture book
minimal_context: Jessica and a volunteer are sitting one-on-one to read the picture book 'What Do You Do with an Idea?'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to read the picture book 'What Do You Do with an Idea?' I want you to try reading this first page in English.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shakes her head quietly, appearing reluctant to attempt any reading in English.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That's alright, I will read the book to you in English. Just listen and follow along.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (She remains completely silent, though her eyes are busy following the book pages and looking at your mouth and eyes while you read.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I've been reading for a while now. Can you tell me what you think is happening in the story?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (She gives a weak smile) 그냥 이렇게 가만히 앉아있었죠. I have been sitting quietly just like this.
